bio: Welcome to Harvard, Class of 2029! My name is Jenn Coulombe and I am a second-year proctor. Currently, I manage a master’s program at Harvard Medical School. I love exploring new restaurants, hiking, board games, and building things. Looking forward to meeting you! Community Yards Area Proctors Role Proctors
